notes.title: Celebrate the Holidays with There’s No Santa – FREE Hidden-Object Fun!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371394/11e8f1eae2bd5e797cfa70b43f1420e42b2699f7.png[/img]

We have an exciting festive surprise for you! 🎁 If you love immersive, colorful gameplay, try [i][b]There’s No Santa[/b][/i], a cozy hidden-object game perfect for the holiday season.

[b]🌟 Why you’ll love it:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 festive, hand-drawn locations filled with Christmas magic 🎄
[*] A randomized pool of 60 objects – new challenges every play! 🔍
[*] 3 difficulty levels to match your play style 🔧
[*] Achievements and features like zoom and hints for added fun 🏆
[/list]
[b]And it’s completely FREE![/b] Don’t miss this chance to enjoy the perfect holiday gaming experience. 🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192350/Theres_No_Santa

[b]Bonus! 🌈[/b]
Relax even more with [b][i]Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number[/i][/b] - [b]it's also FREE, including the achievements[/b]. 🏆 Bring [b]over 100 pixel images[/b] to life in your preferred style – classic color-by-number or textured cross-stitching. It’s the ultimate combination of creativity and relaxation!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071670/Pixel_Cross_Stitch_Color_by_Number/
